title: Jakarta WAR with an npm library pulled through mvnpm inside the esbuild plugin realm, deployed on a Payara image

source.exclude_note: paths removed from the scratch copy scanners see at source stage: build outputs and caches only, anchored to the project root so node_modules/*/dist and the like stay intact

shipped.note: a plugin dependency of esbuild-maven-plugin, bundled into assets/app.js; never in the project graph

not_shipped.note: compile-time only; Payara supplies the implementation at runtime

not_shipped_prefixes.note: the whole jakarta.jakartaee-web-api closure is provided scope: compiled against, supplied by Payara at runtime, absent from the WAR; at image stage Payara's own jakarta.* jars legitimately ship, so the rule applies to source and artefact only
node_modules/ in the project is the esbuild toolchain the esbuild-maven-plugin installed; no npm package ships as a package (lodash-es ships as bundled bytes and is listed under shipped)
